findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before checking its exceptions
findings.body: Setting deletedAll to true only prevents the reader's next iteration; a groups() request can still be in flight when caughtExceptions is checked. If that request fails, its exception can be recorded after the assertion has passed, allowing this regression test to pass despite the concurrent-access failure. Retain the reader thread and join it before asserting so all read results are accounted for and no request overlaps fixture teardown.

findings.title: Stop the background reader even if deletion fails
findings.body: If any remove() call throws, execution skips deletedAll.set(true), leaving the background thread polling indefinitely. Because the thread is not a daemon and has no other termination condition, a failed test leaks a reader that continues accessing the realm during teardown and subsequent tests and can prevent JVM shutdown. Signal termination in a finally block and ensure the reader is joined on failure as well as success.
